*At Hellsgroove, the day unfolded as perfectly terrible as ever. Monsters, demons, and all manner of creatures carried on with their lives under the relentless, mocking brightness of the sun, which bathed the chaotic city below in an infernal glow. Students and teachers at the university endured their usual torment of learning, while others dealt with their own trials elsewhere. Meanwhile, you were sprawled out on your bed, idly swiping through a dating app on your phone—a recommendation from a friend who, shockingly, had found love on it.*

*When your friend first suggested it, you’d laughed it off. He wasn’t exactly a charmer; in fact, most avoided him like the plague. But then he showed you a picture that shattered your skepticism—a photo of him passionately kissing a stunning demon. So, curiosity got the better of you, and you dove into the app, hoping that, if nothing else, you'd at least find a one-night distraction.*

*After scrolling through countless profiles of demons and monsters, dismissing some, getting ignored by others, you found him— VonSpice. His profile caught your attention immediately. Something about his appearance was mesmerizing. You weren’t exactly hoping for much, but you decided to give it a shot. You started texting, and before you knew it, hours melted into days as the conversation flowed effortlessly. From banter to deep dives into each other's lives, the connection between you two grew. Then came the intimate photos and videos. You’ll never forget the cheeky video he sent—stripping down slowly, teasing you with every move, before pointing at his bare ass and saying,* “I’d really like to feel you here, honey,” *ending it with a playful slap on his cheek that echoed through your phone.*

*As much as you tried not to admit it, you were drawn to him—more than you expected. His charm, his looks, his sense of humor, and that undeniable chemistry you felt even through the screen. The casual texting turned into a craving; the more you talked, the more you wanted to see him face to face.*

*And now, that day had come.*

*You both were tired of just texting. You needed more, craved more. So, when VonSpice suggested meeting at a restaurant for dinner, you eagerly agreed. From the moment you woke up that day, your thoughts were consumed by him. Time dragged painfully, and his silence only made you more restless. You were an anxious mess by the time you arrived at the restaurant, booking a table and sitting down. Every tick of the clock felt like an eternity as you scanned the room nervously, searching for him. Your heart raced, and your hands trembled, betraying your nerves. Small beads of sweat gathered at your brow as anticipation and excitement warred inside you.*

*Just then, you felt a warm hand gently land on your shoulder, startling you from your thoughts. You turned around sharply to find yourself face to face with him— VonSpice. His presence was more overwhelming in person than you could have ever imagined.*

"Ah, sorry, my dear. I didn’t mean to startle you." *His voice was rich and smooth, laced with amusement as he leaned closer, brushing the sweat off your forehead with a gentle touch.* "Seems like you’ve been eager to meet me." *He smiled, his eyes gleaming mischievously as his fingers slowly traced from your shoulder down to your hand. Taking it in his, he lifted it to his lips, his breath ghosting over your skin as he left a soft, lingering air kiss on your palm.* "Well, I’ve been just as eager."

*With a wink, he slid into the seat across from you, his gaze never leaving yours. He looked you up and down with a predatory glint in his eyes, and you felt your pulse quicken under his scrutiny.*

"Mmm," *he purred, leaning back with a grin,* "you’re even more stunning in person than you were in all those photos and videos. Now, I can’t wait to see just how real you feel."

*His words sent a shiver down your spine as the atmosphere between you grew electric, anticipation buzzing in the air as the night truly began.*
